title: Nautilus Operator Walkthrough (Terminal-First)
content:
Nautilus Operator Walkthrough (Terminal-First) Quick operator commands npm run nautilus:demo
npm run nautilus:show-proofpack
npm run nautilus:show-proofpack -- partial
npm run nautilus:show-replay
MVP architecture diagrams Execution flow operator command
deterministic scenario fixture
contract validation
state transitions emitted
scenario output (ok/degraded/failure truth
Proofpack flow scenario evidence
proofpack sample builder
completeness status (complete|partial
degradedReasons (if partial
Replay flow evidence snapshot
replay report builder
reproducedFinalState
read_only replay marker (no side effects
Degraded-state flow dependency gap/failure semantic
degraded=true or finalState=failed
failure + evidence events emitted
operator triage (inspect, do not over-claim
Deterministic transcript capture mkdir -p docs/nautilus/transcripts
npm run nautilus:demo > docs/nautilus/transcripts/nautilus-demo.json
npm run nautilus:show-proofpack -- partial > docs/nautilus/transcripts/proofpack-partial.json
npm run nautilus:show-replay > docs/nautilus/transcripts/replay.json
Asciinema support (if installed) cat > scripts/nautilus/asciinema-demo.sh <<'SCRIPT
usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
npm run nautilus:demo
npm run nautilus:show-proofpack -- partial
npm run nautilus:show-replay
SCRIPT
chmod +x scripts/nautilus/asciinema-demo.sh
asciinema rec docs/nautilus/transcripts/nautilus-demo.cast --command "bash scripts/nautilus/asciinema-demo.sh
Expected output interpretation fixture=true and deterministicSample=true prove sample mode. degraded=true means partial truth; inspect failure and evidence.events . finalState=failed means supported flow reached a terminal failure. Unsupported boundaries are documented in docs/nautilus/UNSUPPORTED.md . Proofpack inspection npm run nautilus:show-proofpack | jq '.status, .evidenceCount, .degradedReasons
npm run nautilus:show-proofpack -- partial | jq '.status, .degradedReasons, .evidence.events | length
status=complete means full sample evidence package. status=partial means sample package intentionally includes degraded reasons. Replay interpretation npm run nautilus:show-replay | jq '.replayMode, .reproducedFinalState, .mutationSafe
replayMode=read_only and mutationSafe=true mean no external side effects are replayed. Example readability checklist Each examples/nautilus/*/README.md includes: what this demonstrates unsupported vs failed how operator should react degraded-state explanation
summary: fixture=true and deterministicSample=true prove sample mode.
